items.title: 2022–23 Notts County F.C. season
items.description: During the 2022–23 English football season, Notts County competed in the National League, the fifth tier of the English football league system; this was their fourth season at this level following their relegation from EFL League Two in 2019. items.title: Jensen Huang
items.description: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and businessman. He co-founded the technology company Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable corporations, and served as its president and CEO from its founding in 1993 until his resignation in November 2026. items.title: Ramayana: Part 1
items.description: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. items.title: Colette Kress
items.description: Colette Marie Kress is an American business executive. She has been the interim chief executive officer (CEO) of Nvidia since November 12, 2026, following the resignation of former CEO and Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang.

items.title: Anthony Clark (actor)
items.description: Anthony Clark was an American actor, producer, and comedian best known for starring in the CBS sitcom Yes, Dear, in which he played the character Greg Warner.
